root_cause: Build 1902 had two coupled scoping defects: submitTripForm was still declared inside initialize(), and its closing brace was missing before window.reisslimSubmitTrip=submitTripForm. The assignment was therefore inside submitTripForm itself, so the real handler could not exist before the first submit. The critical bridge waited, found no handler, and displayed 'De planner is nog niet volledig geladen.'
fix: Closed submitTripForm at the correct scope.
Moved submitTripForm and window.reisslimSubmitTrip to module top level before initialize().
Handler now exists as soon as app.js evaluates, independent of initialize().
